name: Wells Fargo
description: Wells Fargo is a US bank holding company that earns mostly from the gap between interest on loans and interest paid on deposits (net interest income $47.5B of $83.7B revenue in 2025) and from fees ($36.2B noninterest income: wealth and brokerage advisory fees, cards, mortgage, investment banking, markets trading). It reports four segments: Consumer Banking and Lending, Commercial Banking, Corporate and Investment Banking, and Wealth and Investment Management. The Federal Reserve asset cap on its growth was removed in 2025, and it repurchased $17.7B of stock that year. Consumer Banking and Lending is the largest segment by revenue and profit.

employees.note: Approximately 205,000 active employees, about 76 percent in the United States (10-K Item 1, as stated for the fiscal year-end).

businessLines.name: Consumer Banking and Lending
businessLines.how: Takes consumer and small-business deposits and lends through cards, auto, home and personal loans; earns the interest spread (78 percent of revenue, 29,183 of 37,362, computed) plus card, mortgage and service fees; provision for credit losses was $3,362M.

businessLines.name: Commercial Banking
businessLines.how: Lends to and holds deposits for mid-size businesses and commercial real estate; revenue fell 6.3 percent (12,778 to 11,978) with net interest income down from 9,096 to 7,902.

businessLines.name: Corporate and Investment Banking
businessLines.how: Lending, treasury services, investment banking advisory and underwriting fees and markets trading for large corporations and institutions; 61 percent of revenue is noninterest income (11,675 of 19,232, computed). Second-highest net income of the four, on a 51 percent pre-tax margin (9,722 of 19,232, computed).

businessLines.name: Wealth and Investment Management
businessLines.how: Advisory and brokerage clients pay fees based on a percentage of the market value of assets under advisement (so revenue rises with markets), plus net interest on deposits and loans; 77 percent of revenue is noninterest income (12,644 of 16,328, computed) and the pre-tax margin is thin at 17 percent (2,810 of 16,328).

businessLines.name: Corporate and reconciling items
businessLines.how: Parent-company treasury, investment portfolio and adjustments that remove double counting between segments; not a business.
